items.overview: A Chartered Accountant who acknowledges that his death is close at hand and becomes isolated in life altogether, loses his mental state and seeks refuge in the pleasure of eliminating the happiness of people around him forever, with a pinch of sadistic desires.

items.overview: The adoptive son of the Adattu family, Marco, sets off on a ruthless quest for vengeance after his brother is brutally murdered, finding only betrayal, loss and unimaginable brutality at every step.

items.overview: In Mumbai, Nurse Prabha's routine is troubled when she receives an unexpected gift from her estranged husband. Her younger roommate, Anu, tries in vain to find a spot in the city to be intimate with her boyfriend. A trip to a beach town allows them to find a space for their desires to manifest.

items.title: Dridam
items.overview: A police officer arrives at a seemingly peaceful station but faces pressure when human remains are discovered. Given only a week to solve the murder, he must navigate demands from his department and an anxious public seeking swift justice.

items.overview: Energetic student Samkutty revives a banned college festival, igniting a fierce rivalry that transforms celebration into chaos.

items.overview: Set against the tense backdrop of a hospital's intensive care unit, the story follows a chaotic day marked by a brutal attack and a sudden family emergency that entangles enemies and loved ones alike. As critical decisions unfold under immense pressure, hidden truths, fear, and fate collide.

items.title: Premalu
items.overview: Sachin, a carefree graduate, crosses paths with Reenu, a spirited IT professional, in Hyderabad. As their friendship deepens, unspoken feelings, career ambitions and life choices challenge their bond.

items.title: Kattalan
items.overview: Power-hungry forces clash in the Ivory cartel war-a fierce story of control, vengeance, and survival where compassion vanishes and only the ruthless endure.

items.overview: Set in the politically turbulent late 1950s, Krishnan Pillai, a playful ruffian chosen by the Church to lead a defensive force, the Christopher Sena. items.title: Vaazha II
items.overview: Four friends – Hashir, Alan, Ajin and Vinayak – are considered losers and troublemakers by parents, family and the school management. items.title: Drishyam 3
items.overview: To protect his family and their dark secret, Georgekutty faces an organized new threat. As walls close in and cracks widen, how much more is he willing to sacrifice?

items.title: Aasha
items.overview: Follows a stubborn, short-tempered widow named Aasha who gets into a tense altercation with a volatile man named Jeemon following a minor road accident.

items.overview: A young man declared brain-dead suddenly awakens with the ability to hear everything. Seeking the nurse whose voice saved him, he's drawn into a dark game of masks, memories, and revenge where every sound may be a clue or a trap.

items.overview: A teenage boy searches for his missing mother following a turbulent childhood and her subsequent disappearance, exploring his search for closure and the truth about his past.

items.overview: Biju is an honest policeman who fights the injustice head-on. items.title: Swaha
items.overview: Set in the background of a village and city, Sreedevi, a woman good at heart gets married to a Unn who was born in a noble family. As she didn't know that the marriage was a trap, she had to suffer a lot. During the life journey, Sreedevi had to face many difficulties.

items.overview: Set in 2007, in the outskirts of Bengaluru, a game of Ouija board goes hilariously wrong when seven bachelors unexpectedly invite a spirit and try to make the best out of the situation.

items.overview: Rohan's affluent lifestyle spirals out of control as he becomes convinced there is a supernatural entity in his home. As he starts to uncover the mystery, he is drawn into unexpected worlds and alliances, along with the horrors that lie ahead.

items.title: Thudakkam
items.overview: When danger strikes, a young woman fights to survive through courage and determination.

items.title: Varavu
items.overview: A family falls victim to the powerful elite in a small town. Time passes, wounds fester. One man's return forces a confrontation that will expose decades of lies and corruption.
